FL-2027-SB44.title: Relief of Sean Hurley by the Orange County Sheriff’s Office
FL-2027-SB44.summary: Relief of Sean Hurley by the Orange County Sheriff’s Office; Providing for the relief of Sean Hurley by the Orange County Sheriff’s Office; providing for an appropriation to compensate Mr. Hurley for injuries sustained as a result of the negligence of the Orange County Sheriff’s Office; providing a limitation on the payment of compensation and attorney fees, etc. CLAIM WITH APPROPRIATION: $20,721,629
FL-2027-SB44.policyArea: general relief bills and local relief bills (claims bills)
FL-2027-SB44.aiSummary: The bill would provide payment to Sean Hurley for injuries linked to the Orange County Sheriff’s Office. It would set aside $20,721,629 for that claim and place limits on the compensation and attorney fees.

FL-2027-SB30.title: Relief of the Estate of Lisa-Maria Carter by the University of South Florida
FL-2027-SB30.summary: Relief of the Estate of Lisa-Maria Carter by the University of South Florida; Providing for the relief of the Estate of Lisa-Maria Carter; providing an appropriation to compensate the estate for injuries and damages sustained by Ms. Carter as a result of the negligence of physicians employed by the Board of Trustees of the University of South Florida; providing a limitation on compensation and the payment of attorney fees, etc. CLAIM: $850,000
FL-2027-SB30.policyArea: general relief bills and local relief bills (claims bills)
FL-2027-SB30.aiSummary: The bill would provide relief to the estate of Lisa-Maria Carter through the University of South Florida. It would set aside money to compensate the estate for injuries and damages tied to care by doctors employed by the university board. The claim amount is $850,000, and it would also set limits on compensation and attorney fees.

FL-2027-SB16.title: Relief of L.P. by the Department of Children and Families
FL-2027-SB16.summary: Relief of L.P. by the Department of Children and Families; Providing for the relief of L.P., a minor, by the Department of Children and Families; providing an appropriation to compensate L.P. for injuries and damages sustained due to the negligence of employees and caseworkers of the department; providing a limitation on compensation and the payment of fees and costs, etc. CLAIM WITH APPROPRIATION: $28,000,000
FL-2027-SB16.policyArea: general relief bills and local relief bills (claims bills)
FL-2027-SB16.aiSummary: Would provide relief to L.P., a minor, by the Florida Department of Children and Families. It would give money to compensate L.P. for injuries and other losses tied to the actions of department employees and caseworkers. The bill includes an appropriation of $28,000,000 and sets limits on compensation and on fees and costs.

It was vetoed by the governor.
